title.narrative: Strengthening national capacities for safeguarding living heritage in Kenya

description.narrative: This workplan is intending to complete the Project “Strengthening national capacities for safeguarding intangible cultural heritage and contributing to sustainable development in Kenya”, financed by an earmarked contribution to the Intangible Cultural Heritage Fund from the Netherlands to Funding Priority 1 under the 2003 Convention. While the initial phase (2022-2024) achieved significant progress – including stakeholder mobilization, community-based training workshops, and the establishment of an Interim National ICH Team – some activities remain pending largely because the project faced delays and disruptions due to political restructuring.
